findings.title: Negative process limits crash flusher initialization
findings.body: The `--flusher-processes` option accepts any integer, but a negative value makes `num_processes` negative and creates an empty `process_to_shards_map`. With assigned shards, the distribution loop then computes an index and looks it up in that empty map, raising `KeyError` while the consumer starts. Validate the option as positive or reject invalid values before building the map.

findings.title: A join timeout can leave later flusher processes running
findings.body: When the deadline expires while waiting for one process, this `break` skips the remaining processes, including their `terminate()` calls. Any skipped worker blocked in a producer operation can remain alive after the consumer has shut down and may continue producing alongside a replacement consumer. Ensure every worker is stopped even after the shared join deadline expires.
